import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
species_colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#95E1D3'}

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=species_colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=species_colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plots for Petal Length
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
positions = [1, 2, 3]
species_list = df['species'].unique()
box_data = [df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].values for species in species_list]
bp1 = ax3.boxplot(box_data, positions=positions, labels=species_list, patch_artist=True,
                   widths=0.6, showfliers=True)
for patch, species in zip(bp1['boxes'], species_list):
    patch.set_facecolor(species_colors[species])
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# 4. Violin plot for Sepal Length
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == species]['sepal_length'].values for species in species_list],
                        positions=positions, showmeans=True, showmedians=True, widths=0.7)
for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(species_colors[species_list[i]])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')
    pc.set_linewidth(1)
ax4.set_xticks(positions)
ax4.set_xticklabels(species_list)
ax4.set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sepal Length Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
